The '''Senate Gala''' was an event held by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Galactic War]]. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Evran]] attended the Gala, and shared a table with [[Supreme Commander]] [[Rans]].
